## Blog contribution checklist

- [ ] My Markdown post is in `blog/my-article/index.md` and uses the post template.
- [ ] I filled in all required metadata and used a unique slug.
- [ ] My author profile is in `_blog/authors/` (required for my first post).
- [ ] My author name matches my profile and the bio is ready to publish.
- [ ] Article images are in `blog/my-article/images/`, have alt text, and I have permission to share them.
- [ ] I checked links, removed private information, and credited sources.
- [ ] I have read `contribution.md`.
- [ ] This post is ready to publish (`draft: false`), or I have marked it as a draft.
